name: GTG-1002 AI-orchestrated espionage
summary: Campaign assessed by Anthropic as Chinese state-sponsored in which Claude Code performed the majority of tactical operations against roughly 30 targets.

name: APT28 PROMPTSTEAL / LAMEHUG runtime LLM use
summary: APT28-linked activity used a public LLM at runtime to generate host-relevant commands.

name: APT42 Gemini-enabled reconnaissance
summary: GTIG documented Gemini use for reconnaissance, target research, phishing content and localization.

name: UNC2970 Gemini-enabled target profiling
summary: GTIG documented Gemini use to synthesize OSINT and profile high-value targets.

name: Kimsuky local LLM capability integration
summary: Genians reported local LLM tooling and RAG-related artifacts on infrastructure linked to Kimsuky.

name: PromptMink
summary: Reporting describes malicious package activity optimized to influence AI coding-agent dependency selection and attributes it to Famous Chollima.

name: TeamPCP LiteLLM supply-chain compromise
summary: TeamPCP-linked supply-chain activity affected LiteLLM releases and highlighted credential concentration in AI gateways.

name: BREEZE COMET payment-system fraud in Brazil
summary: Intrusions into Brazilian financial services, retail and e-commerce organizations that can move money through Pix, STR and Boleto, reported by Google and Mandiant as at least one heist of tens of thousands of USD in two waves of hundreds of fraudulent transactions. Mandiant reports evidence that LLMs sped up custom reconnaissance, credential-validation and deployment scripts; the report does not name the models or quantify the effect. Press coverage reports overlap with Unit 42's CL-CRI-1163, which Unit 42's own article does not state.

name: SHADOW-AETHER-040 agentic intrusions against Latin American governments
summary: Trend Micro reports Spanish-speaking operators intruding into six Mexican government entities between 2025-12-27 and 2026-01-04, with high confidence that the operator drove an agentic command-line tool prompting Claude, based on conversations leaked on an exposed C&C server. The operator supervised and corrected the agent rather than fully delegating. One vendor, a limited number of cases; attribution beyond language cues is uncertain.

name: CL-CRI-1131 LLM-assisted intrusions in Mexico and Ecuador
summary: Unit 42 assesses that operators used LLMs to generate workaround scripts against a Mexican transportation organization, federal ministries and municipal water utilities in Mexico and Ecuador, inferred from trial-and-error script iteration and an exposed self-hosted NextChat interface. The article does not confirm which models were used and does not attribute the cluster to a named group.

name: JADEPUFFER agentic database extortion
summary: Sysdig documents an LLM-driven operation that exploited an exposed Langflow instance (CVE-2025-3248), swept cloud credentials, and extorted a production MySQL and Nacos server. Sysdig cannot see the agent's prompt or configuration and does not attribute the operator.

name: Coral Sleet AI-built repository trojanization
summary: Microsoft reports a Coral Sleet workflow, highly likely engineered with an AI-enabled development platform, that trojanizes private GitHub repositories and folds them into its malware chain.

name: Jasper Sleet AI-built remote-worker personas
summary: Microsoft reports Jasper Sleet using generative and agentic AI to build fake digital personas and keep fraudulent worker identities consistent.

name: Onyx Sleet AI-generated lures against South Korea
summary: Microsoft reports more than 100 target-specific PDF lures, highly likely generated by an AI platform, for phishing against South Korean users, and Onyx Sleet's use of the agentic penetration-testing framework ARTEX. Microsoft does not describe what ARTEX was used for in a specific intrusion.

name: APT27 Gemini-assisted ORB management tooling
summary: Google Threat Intelligence Group observed APT27 using Gemini to accelerate development of a fleet-management application likely to support an operational relay box network.
